question: What will be the percentage change in Ether (ETH-USD on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-17 to the close on 2026-09-08?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-08 / close on 2026-08-17 - 1), using daily closes of ETH-USD on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-08, the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't reach the Yahoo ETH-USD history page, but Yahoo's own coverage points to a 2026-08-17 close of about $1,912. Nothing settles the question yet. Any result from after 2026-08-18 that came up in searches is left out below.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo Finance's ETH-USD history page would not load: the proxy refused the connection. Fortune's price page would not load either. So I could not read the official 2026-08-17 close directly.
- 2026-08-17: Yahoo said ETH opened at $1,874.10 and was $1,894.98 at 9:17 a.m. ET. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-monday-august-17-2026-crypto-prices-down-slightly-as-analysts-question-timing-of-bear-market-bottom-135747407.html)
- 2026-08-18: Yahoo said ETH opened at about $1,911.89 and was about $1,895.37 at 9:19 a.m. ET. Yahoo's crypto day runs on UTC, so the 08-18 open should be close to the 08-17 close. That puts the baseline at about $1,912, but this is an estimate, not checked against the table. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-monday-august-17-2026-crypto-prices-mixed-as-iran-stalemate-continues-155702632.html)
- 2026-08-18: Fortune put ETH at $1,895.85 at 6:45 a.m. ET. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-08-18-2026/)
- One aggregator (Digrin) lists an August 2026 figure of $2,466.82. It doesn't match any of the daily data, so I'd ignore it. [Digrin](https://www.digrin.com/stocks/detail/ETH-USD/price)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-18: Nothing settles the question. The 3-week window has only just started. ETH was trading around $1,890 to $1,915, roughly flat against the 08-17 close. Robinhood's 08-18 contracts settled in that range. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/crypto/events/eth-price-range-on-aug-18-2026-at-4pm-edt-aug-17-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-18: Yahoo's headline was "Crypto prices mixed as Iran stalemate continues." It said ETH was down 5.7% since the Middle East war began in late February. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-tuesday-august-18-2026-crypto-prices-mixed-as-iran-stalemate-continues-155702632.html)
- 2026-08-17: Yahoo's headline was "Crypto prices down slightly as analysts question timing of bear market bottom." Fortune put ETH's market cap at about $233B, down about 57.7% from a year earlier. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-monday-august-17-2026-crypto-prices-down-slightly-as-analysts-question-timing-of-bear-market-bottom-135747407.html), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-08-17-2026/)
- 2026-08-17: Polymarket's "Ethereum price on August 17" market resolved in the $1,900 to $2,000 bracket. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/ethereum-price-on-august-17-2026)
- 2026-08-16: Polymarket's $2,200 to $2,300 bracket for Aug 16 resolved No, so ETH was below $2,200. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/resolved/3451205)
- Mid-July to mid-August 2026: ETH stayed in roughly the $1,800s to low $1,900s. One price table shows a 2026-07-17 close of about $1,844 to $1,863 (its two rows for that day conflict). [myfin](https://myfin.us/cryptocurrencies/ethereum/historical-data)
- 2026-05-28: ETH fell below $2,000 when US-Iran hostilities flared again. The pattern so far: ETH drops on escalation news and rises on ceasefire hopes. [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/prediksi-ethereum-rebound-2026-tom-lee)
- Before August, spot ETH ETF flows had mostly been modest or negative for the year. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/analysis/ethereum-supply-tightens-as-staking-and-etf-demand-reduce-liquid-float-200686622)

## 4. Base rates
- I couldn't download daily closes, so this part is my own rough calculation, not sourced data. ETH's annualized realized volatility usually runs about 50 to 80%. Over the 22 days to Sept 8, that gives a 1-standard-deviation move of roughly ±12% to ±19%, centered near ±15%.
- Moves of 20% or more over three weeks are fairly common for ETH, maybe 15 to 25% of comparable windows. Moves beyond ±40% are rare, mostly limited to crashes or sharp rallies.
- The setup coming in: the 12-month trend is strongly down (-57.7% year on year), and the last month has been a tight range of about $1,840 to $1,950. Low volatility and tight ranges like this often end in a breakout, in either direction.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price from before Aug 18 for ETH on Sept 8. Polymarket has "What price will Ethereum hit in September" and daily markets for early September, but the snapshots I found were dated after Aug 18, so I left them out. [PredScope mirror](https://predscope.com/event/what-price-will-ethereum-hit-in-september-2026)
- I didn't find any expert forecasts aimed specifically at this window.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium. It is Chair Kevin Warsh's first; he took over from Powell in May 2026. The keynote is expected on Aug 28. [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en/news/market-news/jackson-hole-symposium-2026-what-you-need-to-know)
- Weekly spot ETH ETF flow data.
- US-Iran news: the ceasefire and stalemate are the main macro driver named in recent coverage.
- 2026-09-04 (likely): the US August jobs report. The September FOMC meeting comes after Sept 8.
- Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade is not expected on mainnet before Q4 2026, so it shouldn't fall inside this window. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/ethereum-s-glamsterdam-upgrade-enters-final-testnet-phase-ahead-of-q4-2026-mainnet-target)
